content:
Yes, when you run the command `pyenv virtualenv-delete <venv-name>`, it will delete the specified virtual environment, along with all the packages installed within that virtual environment. The virtual environment's directory and all its contents, including the site-packages where the installed packages reside, will be removed.

Make sure to double-check the name of the virtual environment you are deleting, as this action cannot be undone.
